_comment: Copy to secrets.local.json in this directory (gitignored via *.local.json). Every value may be supplied by an env var instead: ATLASSIAN_BASE_URL, ATLASSIAN_EMAIL, ATLASSIAN_API_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, GITHUB_BASE_URL. The Atlassian token needs only read access; the GitHub token needs 'pull requests: read' (fine-grained) or the classic 'repo' read scope.
_githubBaseUrl_note: Only for GitHub Enterprise Server, e.g. https://github.acme.example - omit it entirely for github.com.
